question_text: Mr. Sulieman designed the building of the new hospital in Amman in 2015. The sentence which emphasises the underlined words in the sentence above is......

choices.A: it was Mr. Sulieman who designed the building of the new hospital in Amman in 2015.
choices.B: the year when Mr. Sulieman designed the building of the new hospital in Amman was 2015.
choices.C: it was the building of the new hospital in Amman that Mr. Sulieman designed in 2015.
choices.D: the city where Mr. Sulieman designed the building of the new hospital in was Amman in 2015.
